Marina Stakusic ( Serbian Cyrillic : Марина Стакушић , romanized : Marina Stakušić ; born 27 November 2004) is a Canadian professional tennis player.
She has a career-high WTA singles ranking of world No. 114, achieved on 24 February 2025, and a best doubles ranking of No. 448, reached on 14 August 2023. Stakusic was a member of the Canadian team which won the 2023 Billie Jean King Cup . She has won one WTA 125 singles title as well as four singles titles and one doubles title on the ITF circuit. Early life [ edit ] Stakusic is from Mississauga . [ 1 ] [ 2 ] Her father is a Montenegrin who emigrated to Canada at the age of 25, while her mother was born in Canada to parents who emigrated from Serbia . [ 3 ] Her brother, Marko Stakusic, is also a professional tennis player. She began playing tennis at the age of five. [ 4 ] Career [ edit ] 2022: WTA Tour debut [ edit ] Stakusic made her WTA Tour main-draw debut at the Championnats de Granby where she defeated Jaimee Fourlis in the first round, [ 5 ] before losing to 10th seed Marta Kostyuk .
